titleEn: Buy or enable an add-on outside my plan

en: How do I enable a feature that says super admin must enable?

steps: Features page lists what is on; locked items say a super admin must enable.
edgeCases: Feature off by plan vs off by override vs merchant switch: 403 FEATURE_DISABLED with upgrade target only when the plan is the cause
Mobile: admin pages are responsive; Arabic/RTL: numbers and mixed Arabic/English text must render correctly (Arabic-Indic digits normalised on input)
Provider/outage or rate limit (writeLimiter) returns an error: assistant reports the exact failure and does not claim success
gaps: No add-on purchase flow; super-admin enables only (audit gap 6, High)
assistantNote: assistant says plan/override cause and links billing; cannot enable
